definitions.explanation: Western-style clothes, as opposed to kimono and other traditional Japanese dress, or the state of being dressed in them. Used mostly where the contrast with Japanese dress matters, as at weddings, ceremonies, or in fashion history.

examples.english: I'll attend the ceremony in Western dress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{洋装|ようそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まった→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。
examples.english: Western-style clothing spread during the Meiji era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{和装|わそう}→和装：21261_wasou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{洋装|ようそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: At weddings, many people have photos taken in both Japanese and Western dress.

notes:
⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧ (Western) + {装|そう} (dress, attire). In everyday talk about ordinary clothes, people simply say ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ or ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧; {洋装|ようそう} is used when Western dress is set against Japanese dress.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋装|ようそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in Western dress
- {洋装|ようそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花嫁|はなよめ}→花嫁：04318_hanayome⟧: a bride in a Western wedding dress
- {洋装|ようそう}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: the adoption of Western dress

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和装|わそう}→和装：21261_wasou⟧: Japanese dress, kimono — the direct counterpart
- ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧: Western clothes — the everyday word for the clothes themselves
